{{Top|fga}}
{{Otheruses|algae}}
{{Quote|&hellip;the algae allows us to breathe oxygen beneath the surface for several minutes.|[[Lyric]]|<ref name="Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Greengliepic.jpg|thumb|The green glie, a type of algae]]
'''Algae''' were a group of organisms that typically grew underwater and liked to cover the surfaces of objects. Once thought to be [[Plant/Legends|plants]], they were classified separately as far back as [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TGF">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref> Algae could also be airborne,<ref name="IG-88">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> living on [[Water/Legends|water]] droplets and chemical vapors floating in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="Trouble on Cloud City">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Trouble on Cloud City]]''</ref> Additionally, algae grew on objects out of water, sometimes dangling from structures in strands up to several hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and creating virtual "forests" of algae.<ref name="Boba Fett: Crossfire">''[[Boba Fett: Crossfire]]''</ref>

==Colors==
{{Quote|Those colors are caused by microspheres of airborne algae.|[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], describing [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] clouds|<ref name="Trouble on Cloud City" />}}
Algae ranged in [[Color/Legends|colors]] across the spectrum, including blue,<ref name="Dark Apprentice novel">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> brown,<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> green,<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> orange,<ref name="IG-88" /> pink,<ref name="Trouble on Cloud City" /> and purple,<ref name="Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref> and was sometimes luminescent.<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>

==Uses==
{{Quote|The life energy distilled from concentrated banks of algae and other primitive life-forms can prevent the decay common to previous soul-captures.|[[Lwothin]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>}}
While it was preyed upon for sustenance by some plants and animals,<ref name="Boba Fett: Crossfire" /> some species of algae thrived in a commensal relation with other species, including the [[Melodie]]s of [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]], to which the algae provided life-sustaining [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]].<ref name="Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World" /> Furthermore, varieties such as the [[bestrum algae]] from [[Baralou]] were broken down and processed into foods for consumption,<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> and dried algae extracts were used to create [[algae sugar]] for use in [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] fermentation.<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> [[Algae-bread]] was especially favored by [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], who also made [[Herglic algae ice cream|algae ice cream]].<ref name="Lords">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

Sometime before the [[P'w'eck Emancipation Movement]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], the process of [[Ssi-ruu]]k [[entechment]] was improved upon by harvesting the life energy emitted by algae to prevent the decay of captured souls.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee" />

A more advanced form of algae could be found in the [[Cygnus B system]]. It contained a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] inhabited by giant sapient algae beds.<ref name="CC">{{StoryCite|story=Cantina Communications|book=Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 16}}</ref> Similarly, the planet [[Paulking XIV]] of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] had oceans filled with talking algae.<ref name="GMR">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref>

*[["Glower" algae]]

==Behind the scenes==
Algae, a [[Wikipedia:Photosynthesis|photosynthetic]] [[Wikipedia:Organism|organism]] in real life, was introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' lore by author [[John Chesterman]] in his [[1979]] article "[[Cantina Communications]]," from [[Star Wars Official Poster Monthly 16|''Star Wars Official Poster Monthly'' 16]].
